Package com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.working

Class OrderUpdateBroadcaster

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.working.OrderUpdateBroadcaster
@Component public class OrderUpdateBroadcaster extends Object
Pushes OrderUpdates to the clients who have the order stream open, so a limit or stop order that fills in the background shows up on their screen at once rather than at the next poll.

Each connection belongs to one client and only ever receives that client's orders. A heartbeat every 15 seconds finds connections whose client has gone, and closes ones whose login has ended (without extending its activity), as the price stream does. Sends run on virtual threads, so a slow client can't hold up the trigger engine.
